items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: And so I kept on recording around that way until after years passed in between with Mayo, which we always called him Ink Williams.

ctx.x: Yeah, a piece of paper on it.

And I forget his name now at that time. And anyhow, he says to me, he says, well, gee whiz, you sound almost like that cone yet, and still you got a little more power behind it. And he says, I'm going to get you to make a couple of records with me. And Jell-O'-Roll got me to make a couple of records with him and the guy on the cone and me on his own horn. And so I kept it going for a novelty use for a number of years, and so back and forth with Jimmy O'Brien, Jimmy Blythe. And so I kept on recording around that…
He was running short of wax, this, that, and the other.
